svg.aria-label: Five-stage flowchart: sixteen log entries are hash-chained, hashed into Merkle leaves, paired up to one root, and anchored once on an EVM contract. Entry 7's inclusion path is highlighted in saffron and needs only four hashes; two leaves are deleted but the root still commits to them.
svg.title: From sixteen log lines to one on-chain root
svg.desc: Stages: 1 entries, 2 leaves, 3 pairs, 4 root, 5 anchor. Leaf hash is SHA256(0x00 || entry); node hash is SHA256(0x01 || left || right), the RFC 6962 domain separation that stops a leaf being mistaken for an interior node. One inclusion proof for entry 7 is drawn in saffron: the four sibling hashes it needs are filled saffron, and the other fifteen leaves are not required. Two leaves are dashed because they were deleted after sealing, yet the root still commits to them.
